data.action: 斜倚池边湿身白浴衣，水下手指自抚，紫瞳失神望花影
data.camera: medium shot, misty onsen, wet translucent yukata, sensual solo framing
data.description: 【紫藤温泉·夜雾】为杀鬼磨砺的身体，今夜只为自己松开。忍斜倚在紫藤花影下的温泉池边，队服换成了一件湿透的白浴衣，布料贴出小巧的轮廓。她的指尖在水下轻轻描过最敏感的地方，紫瞳失神地望着花影——「忍、忍术要日日精进……这种事……呜……今夜、今夜请允许我贪心一次……」
data.lighting: 紫藤花影与温泉白雾的柔光
data.promptProse: A body honed for killing demons loosens tonight only for itself. Kochou Shinobu reclines against the rim of a wisteria-shadowed hot spring in a white yukata soaked to translucence, the wet fabric tracing her petite frame as one hand drifts beneath the water over her most sensitive places, purple eyes unfocused on the flower shadows while she bargains with the night for one greedy exception to a lifetime of discipline. Sensual solo composition, wet translucent fabric, cinematic lighting, steam, detailed onsen background.
data.title: 蝴蝶忍 · 紫藤温泉的湿身独处·「今夜……请允许我贪心一次」
